text:
Alex: Quick follow-up from the on-prem packaging RFC — we need a concrete handoff pattern for upgrades when runtime metadata changes (ABI/schema/runtime flags) and the site is air-gapped. Thinking about validation, rollback, and key rotation constraints.
Maya: +1. Main constraint is: agent must be able to validate compatibility without external lookups. suggest a small compatibility manifest bundled with the artifact that the agent can evaluate.
Ravi: Compatibility manifest sounds right. It should enumerate: min_runtime_version, optional_feature_flags, migration_steps (short), and a compatibility_hash for declared files.
Sam: For atomicity in apply, we can't rely on a single inode swap across kernels. Use content-addressed install dirs: /opt/rwinfer/releases/<content-hash>/active -> symlink, but on some constrained boxes symlink perms are flaky.
Maya: fallback: activation marker file with ordered state transitions. Agent applies to new dir, writes "activating:<hash>" then flips to "active:<hash>" only after post-checks. If activation fails, agent reverts to previous active hash.
Alex: Example activation check snippet:
```
# agent pseudo
if verify_signature(bundle.sig, trusted_keys) && manifest.check(runtime_snapshot):
  extract_to(tmpdir)
  run smoke_tests(tmpdir)
  write_atomic(state_file, "active:" + hash)
else:
  abort
```
Sam: We should keep smoke tests minimal (serve a health endpoint, load small model slice) to keep time bounded.
Ravi: About incompatible config migrations: manifest should include a one-line migration hook like `migrate: replace-config:v2` and a reference to a migration script path inside bundle. Agent runs it under a short sandbox and with timeout.
Alex: Key rotation in air-gapped: how do we push new signing keys? Can't rely on CA calls.
Maya: Include key-epoch metadata in bundles. Agent ships with a root_keys.json containing currently-trusted key IDs + the previous epoch. Bundles can be signed by either current key or next_epoch_key if cross-signed. On first apply, agent accepts next_epoch_key signatures and stores the new key to disk as trusted for subsequent updates.
Sam: Essentially allow 'key grace window' of N bundles/30 days. Need ops docs for secure initial key injection and for emergency manual key revoke.
Ravi: Also propose including a bundle-level `compatibility_review` short text that fields ops notes for manual audits — helps offline compliance teams.
Alex: release-bot can help: when we produce an airgap bundle, bot stamps checksums and lists signing key id. Example:
release-bot: bundle: rwinfer-airgap-20240713.tar.gz sha256:3b6f... key_id:rk-2024-07
release-bot: manifest: {"min_runtime": "1.9.0", "migration": "replace-config:v2"}
Maya: Action items: (1) add manifest schema (min_runtime, flags, migration, comp_hash, signing_key_id) (2) agent: implement activation marker + smoke tests + migration hook sandbox (3) ops: document key epoch procedure and grace window.
Alex: Cool — I'll open minimal RFC follow-up PR with the manifest schema and agent-state machine diagram. Any blockers?
Ravi: None from me, but add explicit timeout and resource caps for migration scripts.
Sam: Agree. Also include retry/backoff policy for failed activation attempts so we don't thrash at boot.
Alex: Great. I'll create the PR and tag @Maya @Ravi for review. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
